channel.title: Japan Small-Cap Filings in English
channel.description: English fact summaries of Japanese corporate filings from EDINET.

item.title: IBC Co., Ltd.: OPI IT Holdings launches tender offer for IBC Co., Ltd. at 1,490 yen per share.
item.description: Tender offer period runs from 2026-11-12 to 2026-12-24 (30 business days). | Offer price is 1,490 yen per share of common stock. | Minimum number of shares to be purchased is 2,508,200 shares (45.13%); no upper limit is set. | Shareholding ratio after the tender offer is stated as 66.67% (expected). | The target's board resolved to express support for the offer and recommend that shareholders tender. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Internetworking and Broadband Consulting Co.,Ltd.: Target's board on 2026-11-11 resolved to support and recommend OPI-IT Holdings' tender offer.
item.description: Tender offer period: 2026-11-12 to 2026-12-24 (30 business days) | Tender offer price: 1,490 yen per common share | Minimum shares to be purchased: 2,508,200 shares; no maximum set | Kato Hiroyuki (largest shareholder, 37.14%) agreed to tender all 2,064,200 shares | Plus Fuji Co., Ltd. (9.00%) agreed not to tender its 500,000 shares (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: SEMITEC Corporation: SEMITEC receives about 2,688 million yen in dividends from a consolidated subsidiary.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-11. | Dividend received from a consolidated subsidiary of approximately 2,688 million yen, in standalone results for the first half of the fiscal year ending March 2027 (2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30). | Approximately 2,688 million yen to be recorded as non-operating income in standalone Q2 results for the fiscal year ending March 2027. | The dividend is eliminated in consolidated accounts, so there is no impact on consolidated profit or loss. | Filed under Article 19, Paragraph 2, Item 12 of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Advance Create Co.,ltd.: Advance Create discloses improper accounting findings and special losses from investigation and restatement.
item.description: Board resolution date for the event: 2026-09-18 | Third-party committee investigation report received on 2026-07-31 | Special investigation costs recorded: JPY 274,537 thousand | Impairment loss recorded: JPY 205,978 thousand | Provision for loss on debt guarantee recorded: JPY 23,018 thousand (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: AIPHONE CO.,LTD.: Aiphone reports Ichikawa Co., Ltd. became a major shareholder with 11.71% voting rights on 2026-11-11.

Not investment advice.)

item.title: Sharp Corporation: Sharp to transfer fixed assets in Mie Prefecture to Nitto Denko for 22,200 million yen.
item.description: Event occurred and sale contract was signed on 2026-11-12. | Assets are land and buildings located in Tsu, Mie Prefecture, with transfer price 22,200 million yen and book value 0 million yen. | Expected gain on transfer is 21,449 million yen; expected extraordinary gain on sale is 21,533 million yen. | Buyer is Nitto Denko Kabushiki Kaisha; representative is Akagi Tatsuya, Representative Director and President. | Scheduled delivery date is 2026-12-24; gain to be recorded in Q3 FY ending March 2027 consolidated and non-consolidated results. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Resonac Holdings Corporation: Resonac board resolves to transfer graphite electrode business; expected loss about 105 billion yen.
item.description: Board resolution and event date: 2026-11-12 | Business to be transferred is the graphite electrode business (including related electric furnace software services) in Japan, the Americas and Europe | Overseas subsidiary shares to be transferred; in Japan and Germany, assets and liabilities moved to newly established companies whose shares will then be transferred | Non-operating loss of approximately 105 billion yen expected in the FY2026 (December) consolidated financial statements, affecting IFRS operating profit; estimate may change | FY2026 full-year consolidated earnings forecast unchanged from the 2026-11-11 announcement (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: AGC Inc.: AGC Inc. plans to appoint Murano Tadayuki as representative director, effective 2027-03-30.
item.description: Board of directors meeting held on 2026-11-05 approved the planned change of representative director (内定). | Murano Tadayuki (born 1965-07-08) is scheduled to become representative director and President and CEO on 2027-03-30. | Murano Tadayuki held 10,400 shares as of the filing date. | Murano Tadayuki is scheduled to become President and CEO on 2027-01 before becoming representative director. | Formal decision is scheduled for the annual general meeting of shareholders in late March 2027 and the board meeting after it. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: NIPPON PARKING DEVELOPMENT Co.,Ltd.: Nippon Parking Development reports shareholder meeting resolutions held 2026-10-29.
item.description: Annual general meeting held on 2026-10-29; filed under Article 19(2)(ix)-2 of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs. | Item 1, appropriation of surplus: dividend of JPY 9.00 per share, total dividend 2,805,056,307 yen, effective 2026-10-30; approved with 99.29% support. | Item 2: 13 directors elected, with support ranging from 93.15% to 98.97%. | Item 3: one substitute corporate auditor (Arisa Nakamura) elected with 99.10% support. | Item 4: resolution to delegate to the board issuance of stock acquisition rights as stock options approved with 95.07% support. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: e-Seikatsu Co.,Ltd.: e-Seikatsu signs business and capital alliance agreement with JCOM on 2026-11-12.
item.description: Agreement dated 2026-11-12 with JCOM Kabushiki Kaisha, Minato-ku, Tokyo, Toranomon 1-17-1. | JCOM may nominate 1 director candidate to the company's board. | Company needs JCOM's prior written consent for share issuances or disposals that could dilute JCOM's voting ratio, excluding stock options and share compensation up to 10% on a fully diluted basis. | JCOM may not transfer or additionally acquire company shares during the agreement term without the company's prior consent. | The agreement accompanies a third-party allotment of new shares and a disposal of treasury shares resolved at the 2026-11-12 board meeting. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Japan Transcity Corporation: Japan Transcity board approves employee stock ownership trust plan with 185,300-share treasury disposal.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-12 to apply an employee share grant plan using an ESOP trust for three fiscal years, FY ending 2027-03-31 to FY ending 2029-03-31. | Treasury share disposal of 185,300 shares, allotted to Nihon Master Trust Bank (ESOP trust account). | Disposal price is 1,333 yen per share, based on the 2026-11-11 Tokyo Stock Exchange closing price; total issue price is 247,004,900 yen. | Payment date is 2026-12-01. | Eligible employees numbered 232 as of the board meeting date. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: DIC Corporation: DIC board resolves to inform eligible directors of performance-linked stock compensation rules.
item.description: Board resolution dated 2026-11-12 to inform eligible directors and executive officers of the officer share delivery rules for the BBT plan. | Trust held 243,500 shares as of 2026-09-30; combined total with the planned disposal is 303,500 shares. | Planned disposal of 60,000 treasury shares at 4,783 yen per share, with payment date 2026-11-27. | Total issue amount of 286,980,000 yen for the 60,000-share disposal. | Eligible persons: 3 directors who concurrently serve as executive officers and 16 executive officers. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Nippon BS Broadcasting Corporation: Nippon BS Broadcasting's AGM on 2026-11-11 approved a 30-yen dividend and all resolutions.
item.description: Annual general meeting held on 2026-11-11. | Dividend of 30 yen per common share, total 535,019,820 yen, effective 2026-11-12; approved with 97.22% in favor. | Ten directors elected, including Saito Tomohisa and Tamai Tadayuki; lowest approval rate was 92.63% (Saito Tomohisa). | Abe Toru elected as Audit & Supervisory Board member with 96.01% in favor. | Akamatsu Kiyoshige elected as alternate Audit & Supervisory Board member with 93.30% in favor. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: JAPAN PURE CHEMICAL CO., LTD.: Japan Pure Chemical reports sale of two investment securities issues with 770 million yen gain
item.description: Event period: 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-30 | Company sold part of its investment securities (2 issues) to improve capital efficiency | Gain on sale of investment securities of 770 million yen recorded as extraordinary income | The gain is recorded in the second quarter results for the fiscal year ending September 2026 | Filed under Article 19, Paragraph 2, Item 12 of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Wacoal Holdings Corp.: Wacoal Holdings to dispose of 67,200 treasury shares to employee stock ownership trust.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-12 to introduce an employee share plan using an ESOP trust. | The plan covers the fiscal years ending 2028-03-31 and 2029-03-31. | 67,200 common shares to be disposed of at 3,629 yen per share, totaling 243,868,800 yen. | Payment date for the disposal is 2026-12-02. | Eligible employees as of the board date number 357. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: E-Guardian Inc.: E-Guardian resolved to acquire all shares of Pentio Co., Ltd. under a share purchase agreement dated 2026-11-12.
item.description: Acquisition consideration: 2,000,000 thousand yen for common shares of Pentio Co., Ltd. | Estimated total including advisory fees: 2,007,800 thousand yen; advisory fees 7,800 thousand yen | Target's fiscal year ended 2026-02 sales: 660,073 thousand yen; net income: 105,562 thousand yen | Target's net assets: 469,144 thousand yen; total assets: 1,052,329 thousand yen | Filing states the acquisition would make the target a wholly owned subsidiary (100% of shares) (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: FINDEX Inc.: FINDEX approves disposal of 410,900 treasury shares to employee stock ownership trust.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-12 to inform employees of the stock delivery rules for the J-ESOP trust scheme. | Treasury share disposal of 410,900 shares at 858 yen per share, with payment date 2026-11-27. | Trust held 126,700 shares as of 2026-10-31; combined total is 537,600 shares. | Total issue amount is 352,552,200 yen. | Solicitation targets 297 employees. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: eSOL Co., Ltd.: eSOL board resolves to convene extraordinary shareholder meeting on share consolidation on 2026-12-10
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-12 to convene an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 2026-12-10 for a share consolidation (株式併合). | Tender offer by Kabushiki Kaisha BCJ-110 ran from 2026-09-02 to 2026-10-19 (30 business days). | Tender offer price was 820 yen per share. | Settlement began 2026-10-26; the offeror holds 12,759,681 shares, a 64.70% voting ratio. | Voting ratio uses 19,719,740 shares (20,000,000 issued less 280,260 treasury shares as of 2026-06-30). (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Amazia,inc.: Amazia reports deferred tax asset recognition and subsidiary loan loss provision for FY ended September 2026.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12, the date of the board of directors resolution. | Consolidated income tax adjustment (benefit) of 88 million yen recorded for FY ended September 2026. | Individual allowance for affiliated company loans of 29 million yen recorded as an extraordinary loss. | Individual income tax adjustment (benefit) of 48 million yen recorded for FY ended September 2026. | Loan loss provision is eliminated on consolidation, so there is no impact on consolidated results. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: PLAID,Inc.: PLAID,Inc. resolves disposal of 280,100 treasury shares to 10 executive officers.
item.description: Board resolution dated 2026-11-12 for disposal of 280,100 common shares to 10 executive officers. | Total issue price is 206,713,800 yen, settled by in-kind contribution of monetary claims. | Monetary claim contributed per share is 738 yen. | Payment date is 2026-12-11. | Transfer restrictions run in five tranches, ending 2027-06-30, 2027-12-31, 2028-06-30, 2028-12-31 and 2029-06-30. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: PLAID,Inc.: PLAID reports impairment of 613 million yen on Emotion Tech shares, no consolidated impact.
item.description: Event date: 2026-11-12 (board of directors resolution date). | Impairment recognized because the real value of shares in Emotion Tech Co., Ltd. was judged to have significantly declined below book value. | Equity-method impairment loss on affiliated company shares of 613 million yen recorded as an extraordinary loss in standalone results. | The loss is eliminated in consolidated accounts, so there is no impact on consolidated results. | Filed under Article 24-5(4) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and Article 19(2)(12) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Kudan Inc.: Kudan reports foreign exchange loss and impairment loss tied to currency rate movements.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12, affecting consolidated results for the second quarter (interim period) of the fiscal year ending March 2027. | Foreign exchange loss of 70,626 thousand yen recorded as non-operating expense; first-quarter foreign exchange gain was 77,386 thousand yen. | Causes: exchange rate fluctuations in pound, euro and dollar, plus an impairment loss on acquired research and development and other fixed assets. | Filed under Article 24-5, Paragraph 4 of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and Article 19, Paragraph 2, Item 19 of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: ZENSHO HOLDINGS CO.,LTD.: Zensho Holdings discloses disposal of 170,000 treasury shares for share-based compensation trust.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-12 to dispose of 170,000 common shares of treasury stock | Issue price is 12,705 yen per share; total issue price amount is 2,159,850,000 yen | Payment date is 2026-11-27 | Trust held 237,900 shares as of 2026-10-31; combined total is 407,900 shares | Shares are for the Board Benefit Trust covering fiscal years ended March 2026 to March 2028 (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd.: Kyokuto Boeki reports 736 million yen special loss from offshore wind observation equipment failure
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12, the date of the board meeting that approved the interim financial statements | Observation equipment installed for some offshore wind observation contracts malfunctioned, halting operations and preventing acquisition of contracted observation data | The company judged it difficult to gain an outlook on performing the contracted services for this equipment after failing to achieve root-cause investigation and recovery | A special loss (order-related business loss) of 736 million yen was recorded in the interim period for the fiscal year ending March 2027 and the interim consolidated period | The equipment was procured from an observation service provider, which also handles operation, maintenance and data provision under the contract (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Peers Co.,Ltd.: Peers announces 10th stock acquisition rights issue for directors and employees, 3,218 rights.
item.description: Board resolution dated 2026-11-12 to issue 10th stock acquisition rights, 3,218 rights of 100 shares each (321,800 shares). | Issue price is 100 yen per right; exercise price is the 2026-11-11 closing price of 390 yen multiplied by 101%. | Allotment date is 2026-11-27; exercise period runs from 2026-11-30 to 2036-11-29. | Offerees: 2 directors (600 rights), 27 employees (2,518 rights), 1 subsidiary representative director (100 rights). | Rights certificates will not be issued, and transfer of the rights requires board approval. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: PowerX, Inc.: PowerX signs commitment line and long-term loan agreements with Chugoku Bank, Ltd.
item.description: Agreements signed 2026-11-12; resolved by the executive board on 2026-11-04. | Commitment line limit 1,000 million yen; individual borrowing of 1,000 million yen scheduled for 2026-11-16. | Commitment line maturity 2027-10-29; long-term loan maturity 2029-09-30. | Collateral is company-owned real estate. | Covenants: net assets at least 75% of the higher of the FY2025 or prior year-end amount; ordinary income not losses for two consecutive years, first tested for FY2027. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: CHANGE Holdings, Inc.: CHANGE Holdings records a 5,968 million yen goodwill impairment at subsidiary E-Guardian.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12, per the filing's stated date of occurrence. | The impairment concerns goodwill of consolidated subsidiary E-Guardian Co., Ltd., following a review of future plans in the current business environment. | The impairment was made under IAS 36 (Impairment of Assets) in the second quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. | A goodwill impairment loss of 5,968 million yen will be recorded as an expense within operating profit in the six-month consolidated results for the fiscal year ending March 2027. | The report was filed under Article 24-5(4) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and Article 19(2)(19) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: SQUEEZE inc.: SQUEEZE inc. records impairment loss of 110,144 thousand yen on unlisted investment securities.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12, the date of the board of directors meeting. | The company impaired unlisted investment securities whose substantial value fell significantly below acquisition cost. | Investment securities valuation loss of 110,144 thousand yen recorded as an extraordinary loss. | The loss was recorded in both standalone and consolidated results for Q3 of the fiscal year ending December 2026. | Filed under Cabinet Office Ordinance Article 19, Paragraph 2, Items 12 and 19. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: HEALIOS K.K.: HEALIOS K.K. discloses significant financial income and expense items for Q3 cumulative period
item.description: Date of occurrence: 2026-11-12 (executive officers' board resolution date) | Valuation gain on securities of 1,223 million yen recorded in financial income; total financial income of 1,275 million yen for the fiscal year ending December 2026 third quarter consolidated cumulative period | Derivative valuation loss of 763 million yen, non-cash, from fair value changes of the 21st, 22nd, 26th and 27th stock acquisition rights | Transfer of profit or loss to external investor interests in the Saisei fund of 655 million yen recorded in financial expenses | Total financial expenses of 1,541 million yen for the same period (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: NAKAMURA CHOUKOU CO.,LTD.: Nakamura Choukou reports impairment loss of 10 million yen and litigation costs of 19 million yen.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-08-10. | Impairment loss of 10 million yen recorded on basic software systems and office equipment held by the company and its subsidiary. | Litigation-related expense of 19 million yen recorded as an extraordinary loss, being fees paid to counsel for the international arbitration with Jiangsu Sanchao. | Both amounts recorded as extraordinary losses in the interim consolidated accounting period of the fiscal year ending March 2027. | Report submitted under Article 19, Paragraph 2, Items 12 and 19 of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure of Corporate Affairs. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Altech Corporation: Altech announces change of representative director effective 2027-01-01.
item.description: Board of directors resolved the representative director change on 2026-11-12. | Ota Hideyuki (born 1972-11-19) is to become representative director and president, effective 2027-01-01 (planned); previously director. | Ota Hideyuki held 114,971 shares as of the filing date. | Sudo Taishi (born 1962-12-11) will cease to be representative director and president, effective 2027-01-01 (planned), and become an adviser. | Sudo Taishi held 116,571 shares as of the filing date. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: SQUEEZE Inc.: SQUEEZE Inc. board approves 10th stock acquisition rights for its representative director.

Not investment advice.)

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: LOGOS HOLDINGS INC.: LOGOS HOLDINGS resolved to enter a 500 million yen unsecured loan agreement with financial covenants.

(Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: TAUNS Laboratories, Inc.: TAUNS Laboratories reports Kurabo capital and business alliance agreement and expected major shareholder change.

Not investment advice.)

item.title: FLECT Co., Ltd.: FLECT reports order loss provision of 98 million yen for an ongoing project.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-12, the date of the board of directors resolution. | Some ongoing projects prioritized quality and progress, so costs above plan are expected. | Order loss provision of 98百万円 (98 million yen) was recorded in cost of sales in the second quarter accounting period. | The 98 million yen impact falls in the fiscal year ending March 2027, second quarter accounting period. | Filed under Article 24-5(4) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and Article 19(2)(12) of the Cabinet Office Ordinance on Disclosure. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: AKEBONO BRAKE INDUSTRY CO., LTD.: Akebono Brake reports a covenant breach on its JPY 32,000 million loan; lenders waive default rights.
item.description: Loan agreement dated 2024-06-14 with a syndicate of 8 companies led by Deutsche Bank Tokyo Branch as arranger and agent | Principal of JPY 32,000 million, with repayment due at end of June 2029 | Debt service cover ratio for the period ended 2026-09-30 was below the 1.05x threshold; the event occurred on 2026-11-12 | Lenders agreed on 2026-11-06 to waive default and acceleration rights for the period ended 2026-09-30, and a similar waiver is expected for the period ending 2026-12-31 | Company states the matter does not significantly affect its funding or business continuity; main causes are inventory build-up and temporary working capital increase (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: LOGOS HOLDINGS INC.: LOGOS subsidiary plans 500 million yen loan with financial covenants, signing 2026-11-13.
